question: Which of the following digital programmes aims to make the legislative proceedings of the State and Union Territory Legislatures in India completely paperless?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA)** is a **mission-mode project** initiated by the Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs to promote **paperless functioning** of State and Union Territory Legislatures in India.
 
• It aims to transform legislative proceedings into a **digital, environment-friendly format** by reducing the use of paper, thereby contributing to sustainable governance.
 
• The implementation of NeVA enables legislators to access all relevant legislative documents such as **agenda, bills, notifications, and reports** through electronic devices like tablets or laptops.
 
• NeVA is aligned with the broader vision of **Digital India** to improve transparency, efficiency, and accessibility in governance.
 
• This application ensures real-time availability of legislative data and allows seamless integration of the operations of legislatures across India.
